chapters: Jano' ba' oi'ñga' vaik gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa suudai' u'va gu tasi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu Jerusalem jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan do'ñcho gu noobh gu ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa baasɨ'n gu ux gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jix bhɨɨ gu oidha' cham gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ux gu vaak chumñigam gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Aspenas gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt jix bhɨɨ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ma'nkam vaak ja'tkam chiñia'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook cham gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook jix bhai' gu suudai' gu chuukug bɨx matda' mamatdagɨm gu ja'tkam jix bhai' gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu kutun gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt nɨɨn gu Kaldeos.
Jano' ba' nɨi'ñchudat gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai' na ba' gu tanoolh gu jodai' jugi gu gɨ'kora' suudai' u'va i'i; na gu bhóogɨt vaik gu takarui' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu Danieel gu Ananiias gu Misael gu Asariias.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' jix dhaas gu Danieel gu Beltsasar; mi' dhɨr gu Ananiias gu Sadrak; jano' ba' gu Misael gu Mesak; gio ba' gu Asariias gu Abed-nego.
Jano' ba' gu Danieel jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ cham gu chuukug gu jodai' jugi gu gɨ'kora' tu' suudai' u'va i'i; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ux gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt cham gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Jawatan Dios gu Danieel nɨidhidha' jix bhai' aagak bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt; gio ba'.

Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu Danieel; gio ba' no'ñ choo'n gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' nɨi'ñchudat jugi gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' gu oi'ñga'n buupui gu vupui gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook tuutu'm gu takarui' jix duñia' na ba' bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' mo'o.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Danieel gu oi'ñga'n ka't gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu Danieel gu Ananiias gu Misael gu Asariias.
Jano' ba' gu maa'nkar tu' soi'ñ tu duukam mambhɨɨx gu tanoolh gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jugi gu suudai' i'i.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug vupui bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu ñi'ook kua'da' gu jodai' jugi gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' bhaan jix duñia' jix duu bɨɨx tu duukam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx mambhɨɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu maa'nkar mambhɨɨx gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu vupui tutkɨ gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook jugi gu jodai' jugi gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu oi'ñga'n jix bhɨɨ gu jodai' jugi suudai' u'va i'i jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam maakobh gu ñi'ook jix maa gu Jawatan Dios machia' gu ja'tkam bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam; gu' gu Danieel jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu oi'ñga'n tɨɨtki'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook ka't tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt jix bhɨɨ vupui bhaan gu tasi'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx cham ka't gaagam tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx na ja'p gu Danieel gu Ananiias gu Misael gu Asariias; gio ba' jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu chuukug matda' gu ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx mui'kim tutkɨ bɨx nɨi'ñdha' gu tasi' ka't bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Danieel bɨɨx ka'm oi'ñga' maa'n gu gɨ'kora' gu Kiro.
Jano' ba' gook oi'ñga' gu gɨ'kora' gu tasi' gu oi'ñga'n gu tasi' tɨɨtki' jix duñia' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu gɨ'kora' tɨɨt nɨi'ñdha' gu tasi' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu chuukug gu gɨ'kora' tɨɨtki'; gio ba' tɨɨtɨs jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu jodai' gu vaak gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux maachim gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' nɨɨn gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' na ba' bɨɨx tas jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr tu' koox tu duukam gu jodai' gu suudai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu takarui'; gio ba' gu chuukug ka't; mi' dhɨr tu' cham gu chuukug koox gu suudai' ka't gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu vaak ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook koox gu suudai' gu takarui' tu' juana' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' nɨidhat; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' jix duñia' koox gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gookim gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gui'p; gio ba' gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora' koox tu duukam gu jodai' gu suudai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' tu' kakasnira' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n na gu' gu kutun gu chuukug tu' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' tu' cham gu chuukug koox gu duukam gu chuukug ka't gu takarui'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' jix bhai'x jix maat jix duñia' vupui bhaan tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt gu tanoolh; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' ja'xñi koox na ba' tu' gu vaak na jix bhai' jɨ'xdha' jix duñia' gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' gu takarui' tu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gui'p; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu chio'ñ bhaan gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu chuukug gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' dhi' gu oi'ñga'n gu gɨ'kora' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam tu' gu Jawatan tɨtda:―¿Jax gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ nɨidhim gu oi'ñga'n gu tasi' tu' gu chuukug tu' gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu gɨ'kora' gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' tu' cham tu'x jai'ch gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak na jix bhai' cham bɨɨx gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu ux dhi' gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx daak bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu duukam jix aa'ñdhix gu oi'ñga'n bɨx mamatdagɨm gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook mamatdagɨm jix duñia' gu ñi'ook koi'm; gio ba' tu jiim gu Danieel jugi na ba' kooda'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Danieel gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x gu Ariok gu suudai' jix nukadham gu gɨ'kora' ka't gu ñi'ook na ba' kooda' mamatdagɨm gu Babiloonia.
Ba' jix aa' gu Ariok gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook kuiñcha dhi' gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x jano' ba' gu Ariok jix duñia' gu chuukug gu Danieel.
Jano' ba' gu Danieel chɨbiapui jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' koi gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu gɨ'kora' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Danieel gu vaak jix duñia' gu chuukug gu Ananiias gu Misael gu Asariias jugi.
Na ba' na ba' gu oi'ñga'n i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr bhaan dhi' daasak gu Danieel jugi cham gu suudai' bɨɨx mamatdagɨm gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ka't gu jodai' gu Danieel gu i'ii'ñ gu tukaa'; gio ba' gu ux jix bhai' aa' gu Danieel gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr.
Ba' jix aa' gu Danieel; gio ba' ka't gu takarui' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai'; na gu' gu jodai' matda' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu tanoolh jix duñia'; gio ba' gu chuukug gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr jix maa matda' mamatdagɨm gu duukam pui'm.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' jix dhaam suudai' gu jodai' na jix uam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tukgam gu tasi' jix koi bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tattat gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' bhai'ñ chɨɨdak matda' gu jodai' jano' gu chuukug tu' gu bhóogɨt; na gu' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Danieel chɨbiapui gu Ariok gu gɨ'kora' ka't gu ñi'ook na ba' kooda' mamatdagɨm gu Babiloonia; gio ba' ka't jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham gu jodai' mamatdagɨm gu Babiloonia; jano' ba' gu takarui' vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu suudai'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Ariok jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu Danieel vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu chio'ñ bhaan gu Judaa gaagam jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Danieel jup tɨɨt gu Beltsasar; gio ba' gu kutun tu' gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ koox tu' gu suudai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Danieel vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' daasak gu gɨ'kora' gu oi'ñga'n tu' mamatdagɨm tu' gu chuukug tu' nɨi'ñdha' tu' gu suudai' jɨ'xdha' gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora'.

Gu' gu' cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr gu jodai' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook maachim gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam tu' gu takarui' gu maa'nkar gu tanoolh; gio ba' koox gu ñi'ook mo'o bhaan gu ñi'ook dhi'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook jix tɨ'ɨ gu chuukug gu ux maachim ka't gu suudai' gu ux gu kutun; gio ba' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' tu' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu jodai' dhi' daasak cham gu ux matda' tu' ka't gu oi'ñga'n bɨx na jix do'ig gu ñi'ook na ba' tu' gu chuukug gu gɨ'kora' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu suudai' jix gɨ' na jax chu'm; gio ba' dhi' na jax chu'm ka't gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ' gɇ'kamtu'nda' ka't gu bhóogɨt jix tɨ'ɨ ka't tɨɨt vupui bhaan tu' gu oi'ñga'n ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mo'o dhi' na jax chu'm ka't gu chuukug jix uam jodai; gio ba' gu vaak gu novɨ jix toja jodai; mi' dhɨr vook gu jodai' gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk jodai; gio ba' tɨɨt baasɨ'n jix kavɨk jodai baasɨ'n bhi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' dhi' tɨɨgɨk bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham bɨɨx gu novɨ naaka'n na jax chu'm tɨɨt jix kavɨk jodai bhi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' ka't gio jix duñia' jix kavɨk jodai bhi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' na jix uam jix toja jodai jix uam jodai jix duñia' na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu vaak; gio ba' jix búup gu jɨvɨl cham pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook pai'; gu' gu jodai naaka'n na jax chu'm ka't gu kutun gu kavɨk jix duñia' bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' dhi' koox; gio ba' gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gio gu oi'ñga'n gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu chuukug gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr tu' jix maa oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bɨxchu'x gu kavɨk gu kutun.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ gu vaakax yooxi' gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr tu' dhagia' gu novɨ tu' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' bhaan bɨx gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' tu' gu chuukug mii' dhɨr mo'o jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' jix ali' tu'; gio ba' vaik oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu jodai' na jix uam jix duñia' bɨx gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' maakobh ka't jix kavɨk na ja'p jix kavɨk jodai; gio ba' na ja'p jix kavɨk jodai jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bɨx tu'x na ja'p jix kavɨk jodai gu suudai' bɨx dhi' tu'x jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' tɨɨt gu takarui' baasɨ'n bhi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak baasɨ'n jix kavɨk jodai oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ka't gu kutun; gu' gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu kavɨk jix kavɨk jodai bhaan jix duñia' jix kavɨk jodai jɨ'kchi bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bhi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu suudai' gu takarui' tɨɨt baasɨ'n jix kavɨk jodai baasɨ'n bhi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n baasɨ'n ka't oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' jix kavɨk baasɨ'n ka't jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu jodai' mii' dhɨr jix duñia' jix kavɨk jodai jɨ'kchi bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bhi'ñ jix duñia' bɨɨx gu kai' gu jodai' gu' cham jix duñia' maa'n bɨɨx na ja'p jix kavɨk jodai cham gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh dhi' ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' cham pai' dhuuk mɨɨjidha' gu jodai'; gio ba' cham ka't tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu ja'tkam dhi' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu takarui' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' na ba' bɨɨx tas.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu kavɨk ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai cham bɨɨx gu noobh jix duñia' jix kavɨk jodai gu jodai' na jix uam gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai jix uam jodai; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu gɨ'kora' tu' gu takarui' gu ux gu kutun; mi' dhɨr koox jir bɨx bhai' gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' bhaan gu vupui jix duñia' gu Danieel jix aa'ñdhix maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Danieel; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu Danieel jix maa mui'x juana' jix dhaas gu ux gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Babiloonia gu ux gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' bhaan bɨx mamatdagɨm gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' gu Danieel jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' jix dhaas bhaan gu takarui' oidha' gɨ' gu Babiloonia gu Sadrak gu Mesak gu Abed-nego; gio ba' gu Danieel ka't ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam dhi' jix uam jodai gu kutun ka't gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam gu kutun gu vaak gu ja'tkam; gio ba' jix búup yooxi' gu Dura oidha' gɨ' gu Babiloonia.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu oi'ñga'n dhi' gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam ka't jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n dhi' gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam ka't jix duñia'; gio ba' mi'p tɨɨt vupui bhaan dhi' ka't jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam ñiiñio'k.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu chuukug gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu chuukug bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kutun gu ñi'ook jix duñia' dhi' jix uam jodai gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' no'x cham gu takarui' gu suudai' gu tas ka't baas gu ñi'ook gu duukam gu tai gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' gu ux tɨiñ bɨx gu ja'tkam gu chuukug gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu chuukug bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kutun bɨx gu ja'tkam ñiiñio'k gu ñi'ook o'lhia dhi' jix uam jodai gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ux dhi' gu ñi'ook dhɨt gu chichio'ñ gu takarui' jix duñia' tɨtda:―¿Aapi'.
Jano' ba' a'gi'ñchu' bham gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' na ba' bɨɨx tas jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' jix dhaas ñi'ook na tu a'ga bɨx gu chio'ñ tɨiñ gu chuukug gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu chuukug bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kutun gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt dhi' jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt jum duu baas gu ñi'ook gu duukam gu tai gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' cham tu'x jai'ch gu chichio'ñ tɨtda:―¿Aapi' jix dhaas tu' bhaan gu takarui' oidha' gɨ' gu Babiloonia; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Mesak gu Abed-nego; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tu'; jano' ba' cham gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu takarui' dhi' jix uam jodai tu' gu bhóogɨt.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu takarui' bɨɨx gu duukam jix bhɨɨ gu Sadrak gu Mesak gu Abed-nego; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bɨɨx duu gu suudai' dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu'r gu Sadrak gu Mesak gu Abed-nego gu takarui' cham nɨidhat gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu takarui' dhi' jix uam jodai jix duñia'.

Na gu' jano' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' tɨiñ gu chuukug gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu chuukug bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kutun gu jodai' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook na gu' tu' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' ka't mi'x juu'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu duukam gu tai gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't mii' dhɨr namkidhat gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu Sadrak gu Mesak gu Abed-nego tu ñi'ook gui'p gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' cham gu suudai' tu ñi'ook bhaan dhi' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios nɨidhat jɨ'xdha' gu jodai' gu duukam gu tai gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu novɨ gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu suudai' tu' gu suudai' nɨidhat dhi' jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam ka't jix bhuup gu jodai' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu vupui bhaan gu Sadrak gu Mesak gu Abed-nego; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu vaak gu duukam gu tai kɨɨv mui'kim gu jodai' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu chichio'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' na jix uam ga'ra' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu chuukug gu Sadrak gu Mesak gu Abed-nego na ba' mi'x juu'ñ gu duukam gu tai gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu tasi' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook jajannulhi'ñ jix bɨɨx duu mi'x juu'ñ gu ñi'ook gu duukam gu tai gu oi'ñga'n.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu chuukug ka't gu bhóogɨt gu tai jix jai' mɨmɨim gu tai jix duñia' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu suudai' gu Sadrak gu Mesak gu Abed-nego.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam vaik gu chichio'ñ gu Sadrak gu Mesak gu Abed-nego ia'rɨ gu ñi'ook gu duukam gu tai gu oi'ñga'n.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' jix búup jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' cham mi'x juu'ñ vaik gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tai tu ñi'ook gui'p gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr tu'r gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu jodai' maakobh gu chichio'ñ gu takarui' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai gu oi'ñga'n gu tanoolh cham tu'x jai'ch; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' maakobh nɨidhim gu mar gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob gu duukam gu tai gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu Sadrak gu Mesak gu Abed-nego tu duukam jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu Sadrak gu Mesak gu Abed-nego moor tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai.

Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' na ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu tai cham jix duñia' gu chuukug tu' gu ux ɨɨbhidham ka't gu chuukug tu' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' tu' gu ux gu tai ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux.

Ba' jix aa' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios gu Sadrak gu Mesak gu Abed-nego bhañ nobii'ñ jix duñia' tu duukam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' kapbhai' gu chuukug va'k gu ñi'ook tu' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu ux tu' gu ñi'ook gu duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam nɨɨn gu takarui' gu kutun bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Sadrak gu Mesak gu Abed-nego ka't gu jodai' gu vaak ka't jix duñia' gu ux gu ja'tkam; na gu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu ux.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu Sadrak gu Mesak gu Abed-nego oidha' gɨ' gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam ñiiñio'k jix koi bɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' buimɨk gu chuukug jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug jix duñia' tu' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' buimɨk gu suudai' gu jodai' kɨɨ'p oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ aapi' bɨɨx ka'm gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tasi' ka't gu suudai' gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu kutun.
Jano' ba' tu' koox jix duñia' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook mo'o jix duñia' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu ux tu' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook gu kutun vupui bhaan tu' bɨx mamatdagɨm gu Babiloonia gu chuukug gu suudai' koox.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs nɨi'ñdha' gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai'; gio ba' tu ñi'ook koox vupui bhaan gu' cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai' chɨbiapui vupui bhaan tu' gu Danieel gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Beltsasar na ja'p gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jɨɨgi'ñdham tu ñi'ook koox vupui bhaan bham.

Jano' ba' gu Beltsasar gɨ'kora' ja'tkam nɨi'ñdha' tu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n cham tu'x jai'ch tu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jɨɨgi'ñdham gu oi'ñga'n daasak tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook koox buupui gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook mo'o gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu chuukug gu u'u tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' jix duñia' ka't jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' gɨ'lhidha' dhi' gu u'u jix duñia' jix kavɨk jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu tɨkɨr ñiata bɨɨx ka'm gu maa'nkar bɨx gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' vaaso ka't gu takarui' gu i'bhɨ gu tasi' na ba' bɨx ka't jugi; gio ba' bɨtaa'n gu takarui' ɨkgiga'n gu vaakax yooxi' mamraga'n gu chuukug jix koi gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr gu chuukug bɨx gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook mo'o gu takarui' gu suudai' gu vaak jix bhaan tɨmñim gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook jix bhai'x chɨtda; gio ba' gu suudai' gu u'u jix duñia' mamraga'n jix duñia' vaaso jix duñia' gu i'bhɨ; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' gu vaakax bɨtaa'n gu u'uvhig mamraga'n.

Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mi'x dhaas gu oidha' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk jodai gu jodai' na jix uam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaas yooxi'; gio ba' ka't gu jodai' bɨɨx gu suudai' gu tɨkɨr baasɨ'n bɨɨx gu vaakax gu vaas gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ ka't gu jodai' gu i'ii'ñ gu chio'ñ ka't jix maa gu i'ii'ñ gu vaakax gu bhóogɨt bhaan kɨɨv gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ux gu duukam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux tu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n; na ba' gu suudai' na jix do'ig gu Gɨ'kora' Jawatan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu chichio'ñ gu suudai' jix maa gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu tasi' buupui dhi' koox; na gu' tu' gu Beltsasar daipu' gu suudai' na gu' bɨx mamatdagɨm oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu jodai' gu takarui'; na gu' gu' tu' no'p na gu' cham tu'x jai'ch tu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jɨɨgi'ñdham.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Danieel gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't gu Beltsasar juruuñ gu chuukug gu maa'nkar gu tas gu chuukug jix duñia'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' tu ñi'ook jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Beltsasar koox tu' gu suudai' cham tu' gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' jix aa' gu Beltsasar; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu chuukug koox ka't na ba' gu takarui' gu suudai' na ba' cham bhai' tu' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu u'u jix duñia' gɨ'lhidha' jix duñia' jix kavɨk jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu tɨkɨr ñiata gu ux bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' vaaso ka't gu takarui' gu i'bhɨ gu tasi' na ba' bɨx ka't jugi; gio ba' bɨtaa'n jix koi gu vaakax yooxi' mamraga'n oi'ñka' gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' tu' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai' tu' gu oi'ñga'n jix kavɨk jix duñia' gu duukam tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu tɨkɨr aapi' bɨɨx ka'm gu maa'nkar gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu jodai' jix ñi' gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak jix bhaan tɨmñim gu tɨkɨr chɨtda; gio ba' gu suudai' gu u'u gu chuukug; gu' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu oidha' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk jodai gu jodai' na jix uam gu vaas yooxi'; jano' ba' ka't gu jodai' bɨɨx gu suudai' gu tɨkɨr baasɨ'n ka't bɨɨx gu vaakax yooxi' bɨɨx ka'm gu bhóogɨt bhaan kɨɨv gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu chuukug gu Gɨ'kora' Jawatan tu' tɨbiap bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan.

Na tu' mi'x juu'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ bɨɨx gu vaakax yooxi' ka't jix koi bɨɨx gu vaas yooxi' tu' jix duñia' na ja'p gu vaakax bɨɨx gu suudai' gu tɨkɨr ka' gu suudai'; gio ba' kɨɨv gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' bhaan tu' bɨɨx ka'm gu bhóogɨt gu Gɨ'kora' Jawatan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu chichio'ñ gu bhóogɨt maa'n.
Jano' ba' gui'p mi'x dhaas gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'u gu bhóogɨt oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt aapi' gu tɨkɨr.

Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ uañi'ñ bɨɨx bɨx bhai' tu' na cham jir bhai' bɨɨx i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam na ba' bɨɨx bia'; na jix duñia' ka't gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu duukam.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu jodai' suudai' u'va bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu maa'nkar gu kutun masaa'n gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu kutun oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' cham gu chuukug gu Babiloonia tu' gu suudai' na ba' gu vaak oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bɨɨx gu kavɨk gu suudai' na ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu duukam.
Na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' ka't gu ñi'ook gu chin gu gɨ'kora' na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bhaan tu'.

Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ tu' mi'x juu'ñ bɨɨx gu vaakax yooxi' ka't jix koi na ja'p gu vaakax tu' jix duñia'; gio ba' kɨɨv gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' bhaan tu' bɨɨx ka'm gu chuukug gu Gɨ'kora' Jawatan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu chichio'ñ gu bhóogɨt jix maa.

Jano' ba' gu tas jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu tasi' ka't baas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' jugi gu vaas na ja'p gu vaakax gu chuukug jix duñia' bɨɨx gu suudai' gu tɨkɨr bɨɨx ka'm gu takarui' jix duñia' na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n na ja'p gu u'uvhig.

Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ja'tkam gu chuukug gu vupui gu tɨkɨr jix duñia' ka't gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Gɨ'kora' Jawatan gu chuukug tas na jix gɨ' jix duñia' na ba' bɨɨx tas; na gu' aapi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu ux bɨx gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' bɨx jix koi gu oidha' gu ux cham tu' gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr gu suudai' gu oidha' gu ux bhaan aagak; mi' dhɨr tu' cham tu'x jai'ch dhi' gu novɨ gu takarui'; jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' ka't gu bhóogɨt gu kutun oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu duukam suulh tu' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu suudai' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' jix gɨ' gu duukam ka't gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' jano' tu' gu ja'tkam bhai'ñ gu ñi'ook tas na jix gɨ' gu gɨ'kora' gu tɨkɨr na gu' bɨx buimɨi tu'r gu bhóogɨt ñi'ook na jir bhai'; gio ba' gu suudai' jɨ'xdha' gu kutun bɨɨx gu ux.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu gɨ'kora' gu Belsasar gu takarui' gu maa'nkar chiñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu maa'nkar gu jodai' suudai' u'va.

Jano' ba' gu Belsasar bɨɨx gu jodai' suudai' u'va jix aa'ñdhix jix bhɨɨ gu jodai' jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu ja'tkam gu taat ka't gu jodai' vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jerusalem; na ba' gu takarui' bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu suudai' gu jodai' jix uam jodai gu suudai' gu jodai' vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Jerusalem gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu jodai' na jix uam jix kavɨk jodai gu u'u gu jodai.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tas moor gu takarui' gu novɨ gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan mɨichdhai bhaan gu bhóogɨt gu maa'nkar gu kutun vaak ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' gu chuukug gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu novɨ gu o'o.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' jix uam gu chuukug jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ux kɨkbok gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' tu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu kutun nɨi'ñdha' gu takarui' gu suudai'; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' jix aa' mamatdagɨm gu Babiloonia; mi' dhɨr no'x gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' dhi' gu'p gu takarui' gu suudai' ka't tɨi'chu' ñakaabma' gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix uam jodai baakux; jano' ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' jix duñia' vaik.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu takarui' bɨx mamatdagɨm gu gɨ'kora' cham jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu'p tu' gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Belsasar ka't gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' jix uam jix duñia' chiñia'.

Jano' ba' gu vaak gu ux gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' chɨbiapui gu chuukug gu jodai'; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu vaak jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' na ba' bɨɨx tas jix duñia' cham tu' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug tu' jix uam gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' cham tu'x jai'ch gu chio'ñ jix koi gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jɨɨgi'ñdham; gio ba' gu tanoolh gu taat gu ñi'ook gu tasi' gu ñi'ook matda' na ja'p gu duukam gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam gu taat gu gɨ'kora' gu taat jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu bhóogɨt nɨi'ñdha' gu chuukug gu takarui' gu suudai'.

Na gu' na gu' ka't gaagam jix gɨ' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu duukam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' tɨɨtki' gu suudai' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu takarui' maachim gu Danieel; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix dhaas gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Beltsasar; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jano' gu Danieel jix duñia' gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Danieel ka't gu jodai' vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' jix aa' gu Danieel; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug tu' mii' dhɨr gu Danieel gu ma'nkam gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Judaa gu taat jix bhɨɨ gu Judea.
Jano' ba' tu' naak tu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jɨɨgi'ñdham tu' gu ñi'ook gu tasi' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' matda'.
Jano' ba' jano' jix bɨɨx duu gu suudai' vupui bhaan tu' mamatdagɨm gu jodai' gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' dhi' gu'p gu chuukug gu vaak; gu' cham jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu suudai' gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' tu' naak tu' no'p gu suudai' gu takarui' kookoxdha' gu tasi'; gio ba' tu' jano' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n dhi' gu'p gu jodai' gu vaak ka' tɨi'chu' ñakaabma' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix uam jodai gu oi'ñga'n baakux oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ka' vaik gu Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Danieel vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' juana' ka't na ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu'p tu' gu chuukug gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu Gɨ'kora' Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' jix maa gu ja'tkam gu taat oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu jodai' gɇ'kamtu'nda' nɨidhat.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu jodai' jix maa bɨx gu ja'tkam ñiiñio'k gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan; na gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu oidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu suudai' ka't gu oi'ñga'n atooxkor oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bhaan gɇ'kamtu'nda'.

Jano' ba' ka't baas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu vaakax bɨɨx gu duukam gu kakkavɨk ka't gu vaak na jix bhai'; mi' dhɨr gu vaas jix duu jugi na ja'p gu vaakax gu chuukug ka't gu suudai' bɨɨx gu suudai' gu tɨkɨr bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' gu Gɨ'kora' Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu chichio'ñ gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' tu' gu mar gu Belsasar cham jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ pu'ñir bɨx dhi'.

Jano' ba' va'k bhaan gu Jawatan gu tɨkɨr tu' gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu' gu jodai' gu vaak tu' chiñia' gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va; gio ba' gu jodai' dhi' gu Jawatan Dios jix toja jodai jix uam jodai gu jodai' na jix uam jix kavɨk jodai gu u'u gu jodai tu' gu kutun tu' gu suudai' tu' gu i'ii'ñ chɨɨdak bhai' ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu oidha' bɨx gu bhóogɨt cham pai' dhuuk nɨidhat.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n ka't gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu novɨ jix duñia' dhi' gu'p.
Jano' ba' gu'p jix duñia'; gio ba' gu Mene gu Tekel gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu chuukug; gio ba' gu Mene; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu Tekel; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gaagam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Peres; gio ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ka't gu jodai' jix maa gu Medos gu Persas.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Belsasar jix duñia' gu Danieel ñakaabma' baakux ka't gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix uam jodai jix duñia' jum duu vaik gu Jawatan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu tukaa' ka't jix koi gu Belsasar gu gɨ'kora' gu Kaldeos.
Jano' ba' gu Dariio gu Media jix bhɨɨ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gook gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' xoi'kam gu Dariio gu oi'ñga'n bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' chamaam gu ñi'ook gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu suudai' bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Na gu' bhaan vaik gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Danieel ka't maa'n dhi' ja'tkam gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' na gu' gu gɨ'kora' cham gu suudai' gu tanoolh.

Na gu' gu' gu Danieel ka't gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim dhi' ja'tkam gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na gu' ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu tasi' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' bhaan bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Danieel gu ux baasɨ'n oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; na gu' gu' cham gu suudai' gu ñi'ook bua' uañi'ñ na gu' ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' tu' uañi'ñ ka't gaagam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gui'p mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' cham bakia' bhaan dhi' gu Danieel bua' gu ñi'ook tu' cham bakia' bhaan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jum daa'ñ vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gui'p; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dariio na ba' bɨɨx tas jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' o'rosiiris gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu takarui' gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak ja'tkam jir bɨx bhai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim no'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' ka't baas jix bhai'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jano' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu bhóogɨt jir bɨx bhai' gu bhóogɨt gu'p na ba' cham gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Media gu Persia cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dariio gu'p gu ñi'ook.

Na pai' dhuuk gu Danieel na pai' dhuuk gu bhóogɨt gu'p ka't gu chuukug chɨbiapui gu vaak gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim mi'p bhaan gu Jerusalem jix duñia' kɨkbok vaik mui'kim gu tanoolh jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug va'k.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jum daa'ñ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Danieel gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook jir bɨx bhai' vaak ja'tkam; gio ba' cham tu jiim jir bɨx bhai' no'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' jum duu baas jix bhai'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr tu'r jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Media gu Persia cham gu maa'nkar.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gui'p vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu Danieel gu ma'nkam gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Judiios cham tu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' tu' gu ñi'ook gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr va'k vaik mui'kim gu tanoolh gu ux gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jano' ba' tɨiñ gu chuukug jix duñia' bhaan gu Danieel jix dhaas gu ñi'ook na ba' u'ua'tɨda'; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu oi'ñga'n gu tas jix duñia' na ba' u'ua'tɨda'.

Gu' cham gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ jum daa'ñ mia'n gu gɨ'kora' gui'p gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Media gu Persia gu oi'ñga'n gu duukam jir bɨx bhai' gu gɨ'kora' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'ñdhix aichdhak gu Danieel mi'x juu'ñ jix bhai'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' a'gi'ñchu' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa' gu Danieel; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n tu' jix bhai'x gu chuukug tu' namkidhat.
Na gu' ka't gu chuukug gu jodai jix duñia' bhaan ki'ñgob jix bhai'x jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx gu chuukug bɨɨx gu chuukug chiñia' na gu' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu Danieel cham gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu kutun jix duñia' gu vaak; gio ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak jix bɨɨx duu gu suudai' vupui bhaan ka't koox.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu ux gu jodai' jix búup gu bhóogɨt gu xibh ka't jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' jimɨɨk mia'n jix bhai'x jup tɨɨt jiiñak gu Danieel bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix duñia'; gio ba' a'gi'ñchu' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa' gu Danieel; mi' dhɨr gu Danieel tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios na jix do'ig gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n tu' jix bhai'x gu chuukug tu' gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Danieel bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' na ba' bɨɨx tas jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug bhañ nobii'ñ jix kup gu chin gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' cham gu ñi'ook cham bhai'; na gu' vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook tu' bɨx bhai'; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' vupui bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' tu' cham gu ñi'ook cham gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' kuiñcha jix aa'ñdhix gu bhóogɨt gu Danieel jix bhai'x; na gu' ka't gu Danieel jix buusñi jix bhai'x matgɨm gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook na gu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu gɨ'kora' jix bɨɨx duu gu suudai' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu suudai' jix duñia' gu Danieel jix bɨɨx duu mi'x juu'ñ jix bhai'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu u'vɨ; na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' cham gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix bhai'x na pai' dhuuk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' bɨx o'oo.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dariio ua'na bɨx gu ja'tkam ñiiñio'k gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ ka't jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' baasɨ'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' jir bɨx bhai' bɨx aapi' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bɨx gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu Danieel; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios na jix do'ig gu bhóogɨt gu ux bɨx gu suudai' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' jix duñia' cham ka't gu suudai' aapi' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Na dodhia' gu jodai' gu ux buimɨk kɨɨ'p gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Danieel gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu Danieel ka't gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dariio gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Kiro gu Persa.
Jano' ba' maa'n oidha' tas gu Belsasar gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia jix ñi' gu Danieel koox gu ñi'ook mo'o gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ua'na koox cham gu suudai' gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Danieel; gio ba' gu chuukug tu' gu i'ii'ñ gu tukaa' gu suudai' maakobh jɨbɨɨlh gu tɨkɨr jugi gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' maakobh gu vaakax gu oi'ñga'n jix tɨ'ɨ gu gɨ' suudai'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't na ja'p maavɨt ga'ra' gu oi'ñga'n gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; gio ba' tu' ka't tɨɨgɨk bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n jix bɨɨx duu gu chuukug ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr jix dhaas gu oi'ñga'n bhaan tɨɨt gu chio'ñ ka't jix maa gu i'ii'ñ gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gookim gu vaakax nɨidhim gu kutun jix dhaas gu ñi'ook ga'ra' gu chin vaik o'oo tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr bamii' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' tu' jix duñia' gu suudai' nɨidhim gu suudai' ga'ra' maakobh gu oi'ñga'n gu u'uvhig gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' ga'ra' gio dhi' gu vaakax maakobh ɨɨbhidham; mi' dhɨr ka't gu jodai' tajaañ.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' jix duñia' tu' gu ñi'ook gu tukaa' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu vaakax jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' jix kavɨk; gio ba' ga'ra' gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk jodai; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' bɨɨx tɨɨt; jano' ba' ka't gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu vaakax gu suudai' jix duñia' va'k ga'ra' mambhɨɨx a'aa'.

Jano' ba' kua' tu' gu jodai' a'aa' gu suudai' gu maa'nkar jix ali' jix tɨ'ɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan jix bɨɨx duu gu chuukug vaik a'aa' dharka'; gio ba' gu suudai' dhi' gu maa'nkar ka't gu vupui na ja'p gu vupui gu chio'ñ gu chin ua'rgidhimɨk gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug tɨɨgɨk bɨɨx ka'm jix bɨɨx duu gu oi'ñga'n a'toxkar; gio ba' gu Ankiano jix gɨ' gu bhóogɨt jix daa tɨi'chu' ka't jix toja na ja'p jabook gu takarui' mo'o na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook mɨmɨim gu tai gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gɨ' suudai' jiim gu tai gu tanoolh busaak vupui bhaan; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu chuukug vupui bhaan; mi' dhɨr jir bɨx bhai' jix daa gu vaak gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu' jano' ba' jix duñia' kuiñcha gu ñi'ook ua'rgidhimɨk gu maa'nkar; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai' jix duñia' gu vaakax gu chuukug ka't gu suudai' dhagia' na ba' gu suudai' gu chuukug gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gio gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu vaakax aapi' ka't jix duñia' gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm tɨɨda' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' tu' gu i'ii'ñ gu tukaa' gu suudai' tɨbaa'ñ gu tɨkɨr na ja'p gu mar gu chio'ñ gu jodai' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu Ankiano jix gɨ' gu bhóogɨt jix duu gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' ka't jix maa aapi' gɇ'kamtu'nda' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam ñiiñio'k jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr aapi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' cham gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ ka't gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu Danieel tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu ñi'ook mo'o jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' maa'n gu chuukug tu ñi'ook tu'r gu ñi'ook bɨx dhi'; gio ba' tu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu vaak tu'x.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu vaakax maakobh gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' jɨɨgi'ñdham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook maachim tu'r gu ñi'ook gu vaakax gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't bɨx jix bhai'x ga'ra' gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk jodai gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' na jix uam jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' bɨɨx tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx a'aa' ga'ra' mo'o ka't jix tɨ'ɨ vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook gu vaak vaik; gio ba' dhi' gu maa'nkar ga'ra' gu vupui gu chin ua'rgidhimɨk gu suudai' jix gɨ' jugi.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug tu' dhi' gu maa'nkar jix duñia' bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan jɨɨgi'ñdham gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai' suudai' u'va gu Ankiano jix gɨ' gu bhóogɨt jix maa ñi'ook na jir bhai' jɨɨgi'ñdham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu ñi'ook jɨɨgi'ñdham gu vupui oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaakax ka't maakobh oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu oidha' ka't gu oi'ñga'n jix gɨ' bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu oidha' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' mambhɨɨx a'aa' gu suudai' mii' dhɨr oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' bhaan gu ñi'ook ka't jix gɨ' dharka' vaik gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jɨɨgi'ñdham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh ñi'ook na tu a'ga; gio ba' kapbhai' ka't gu novɨ bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook jir bɨx bhai' jix duñia' aapi' na ba' ka't gu jodai' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' aapi' gu kutun gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨtaa'n bɨx gu tɨkɨr ka't jix maa gu ja'tkam jɨɨgi'ñdham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx aapi' gu ñi'ook gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' tu' gu Danieel jix jai' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu vupui jix duñia'; gu' nukadham gu i'ii'ñ gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' oi'ñga' vaik gu gɨ'kora' gu Belsasar jix ñi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu Danieel mi' dhɨr mii' dhɨr ka't gu ñi'ook va'k.
Na pai' dhuuk tu' gu oi'ñga'n ka't na pai' dhuuk tu' ka't gu Susaan gu vaak oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' oidha' gɨ' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n kua' ju'ñdharan gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Ulai.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu vupui gu chuukug gu suudai' gu ñi'ook ka't vupui bhaan gɨ' suudai' jiim ga'ra' gook a'aa'; gio ba' gu ux jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n maa'n ka't gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x jix tɨ'ɨ gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx a'aa' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook saagi'ñ matgɨm gu vaakax gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu' ka't gu takarui' gu novɨ; gio ba' jix duñia' jurtu'nka' aagak gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' kua' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu chio'ñ chiiw gu jodai' baasɨ'n gu jodai' bhaan gu vupui bɨx gu oidha' cham gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; gio ba' ga'ra' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ chiiw gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai'x tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vupui.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook ga'ra' gook a'aa' ka't tu' buupui ka't vupui bhaan gɨ' suudai' jiim dai'bus bhaan bɨɨx gu vaak gu kavɨk.

Na gu' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' ju'ñdharan gu ñi'ook jix búup bhaan naaka'n jix duñia' gook a'aa' na gu' gu ñi'ook cham ka't gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ux gu jodai' gu oidha' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr tu' ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu chio'ñ chiiw; gio ba' kua' jix gɨ' gu kavɨk mii' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu suudai' pai' jix tɨ'ɨ maakobh gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bhaan maakobh jɨbɨɨlh gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' maa'n jix buus gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix ali' jix duñia' jix jai' saagi'ñ tas buusñi bhaan gu oidha' jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' baasɨ'n ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu si'avag mi'x juu'ñ gu ux gu oidha' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk jix duñia' gu ux ka't gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu vaak na jix bhai' gu maa'nkar pai' xidhuu ka't baas gu ux gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't dhagia' kuiñcha gu chuukug bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' gu maa'nkar; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ux gu oidha' tu'r jix duu gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' jix bhai'x.

Jano' ba' tu' jix bhaan ua'rgidhimɨk; gio ba' jɨɨgi'ñdham jix aa' gu bhóogɨt ua'rgidhimɨk; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx ka'm duuk jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak na jix bhai' gu maa'nkar gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' xidhuu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham na ba' gu suudai' gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gook jix bhai'x vaik gu tanoolh gu xumai gu xibh; mi' dhɨr xidhuu ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' kua' tu' gu Danieel gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu suudai' na ja'p na jax chu'm gu chio'ñ jix dhaas vupui bhaan tu'.
Ba' jix aa' tu' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu o'o gu Ulai jix duñia'; gio ba' gu Gabriel gu ñi'ook gu ux.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va mia'n pai' tu' ka't; gio ba' bɨɨx namkia' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug bhaan gu vupui; gu' cham gu ñi'ook jix aa'; na gu' gu chuukug gu mar gu chio'ñ na gu' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' kua' a'gi'ñchu' gu chuukug jix koox gu oidha' bhaan gu vupui; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duu gu ñi'ook tɨɨt.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu kutun gu ñi'ook daak; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix duñia' ga'ra' a'aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Media gu Persia.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ chiiw gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix gɨ' ga'ra' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vupui gu gɨ'kora' maa'n.
Jano' ba' ka't gu suudai' jix duñia' maakobh pai' gu bhóogɨt maakobh gu gɨ'kora' gu chuukug gu ja'tkam gu' cham gu kavɨk.
Na pai' dhuuk gu maa'nkar gu duukam suulhgia' na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' jix bhai'x gu vupui gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu' cham bɨɨx gu kavɨk gu jodai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu tasi'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk gu ja'tkam jɨɨgi'ñdham.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx jix duñia' gu tasi' iatda' gu novɨ; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook mui'x; mi' dhɨr bhaan gu ñi'ook chiñia' jix duñia'; gu' cham gu novɨ ka't jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu xumai gu xibh tu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' tu' jix nukadham gu ñi'ook na gu' na ba' mui'x gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Danieel jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu chuukug ka'ook dhɨt gu tanoolh; na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu gɨ'kora'; gu' ka't gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook cham ka't gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' oi'ñga' maa'n gu Dariio gu mar gu jodai' gu ja'tkam gu Medos ka't gu ñi'ook gu ux gu gɨ'kora' bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Kaldeos.

Ba' jix aa' oi'ñga' maa'n gu gɨ'kora' tu' gu Danieel gu chuukug jix bhai'x o'dam ñi'ook jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jeremiiyas ka't gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem gu vaak gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu vupui gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' soi'm soi'ñ gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook maatai.

Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jano' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix gɨ' suuska'n gu suudai' gu ñi'ook nuuka'n ñi'ook na jix bhaan xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx tu' gu takarui' nukadham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' uañi'ñ gu jodai' gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai' gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x gu jodai' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' gu vaak gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jir bhai'.

Jano' ba' cham gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu tɨɨgɨ' tu ñi'ook gɇ'kam tɨjɨɨ'ñdha' gu gɨ'kora' gɇ'kam tɨjɨɨ'ñdha' chiñia' gɇ'kam tɨjɨɨ'ñdha' tattat bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan bɨx bhai' gu kutun gu jodai' na jix uam gu vupui na ja'p gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Judaa jix koi gu Jerusalem bɨx gu Israeel mia'n gu suudai' bɨx oi'ñga'n pai' baas kuiñcha uañi'ñ bɨɨx bhaan tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu kutun gu jodai' na jix uam gu vupui gɇ'kam tɨjɨɨ'ñdha' gu gɨ'kora' gɇ'kam tɨjɨɨ'ñdha' chiñia' gɇ'kam tɨjɨɨ'ñdha' tattat; na gu' bhaan tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios mambhɨɨx xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch uañchuda' gu ux bhaan gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jiim ñi'ook na tu a'ga jix dhaas vupui bhaan no'ch gu ux gu novɨ tu duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu Israeel bhaan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu takarui' na ba' cham gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ux tu' gu jodai' bhaan gu ñi'ook mu'ai gu ñi'ook ua'nak ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' tu' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook bhaan no'ch bhaan gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' bhaan no'ch gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' cham bhai'; na cham pai' dhuuk ka't gu ñi'ook bɨtaa'n gu tɨkɨr na ja'p ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' bhaan ua'nak ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees bɨx gu ñi'ook cham bhai' suudai' u'va bhaan no'ch; gio ba' cham gu jodai' gu chuukug gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu jodai' gu Dios tu' na cham jir bhai' gu ñi'ook tu'r.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ux gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan cham bhai' jix bhɨɨ bhaan no'ch; na gu' jir bhai' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx buimɨi jix duu na gu' cham gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' jix buusñi gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu Ejipto bɨɨx gu novɨ gu i'ii'ñ tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨɨgɨ' dhi' gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu jodai' uañi'ñ jix bhai'x gu jodai' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan bhaan bɨx bɨx bhai' gu ñi'ook jano' daak i'iich bhaan kiicham gu Jerusalem jix bhaan gu kavɨk; na gu' kuiñcha uañi'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai' uañi'ñ tattat gu Jerusalem gu ja'tkam gɨ' vaak ja'tkam gu jodai' bɨx gu bhóogɨt chulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu takarui' soi'm tu duukam gu suudai' gu vupui jix duñia' bhaan xidhuu gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu Jawatan.

Jano' ba' gu Inklina gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug naak gu takarui'; gio ba' gu jodai' gu vupui gu suudai' bɨx bhai' gu takarui' kiicham bhaan tɨɨgim gu tɨɨgɨ'; na gu' cham gu oi'ñga'n bɨx bhai' gu suudai' vupui bhaan gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug bɨx bhai' gu ñi'ook mumua'da' gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu Jawatan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt naak gu Jawatan gu vupui; jano' ba' cham gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook xoi'kam tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug; na gu' gu tɨɨgɨ' tɨɨgim bhaan kiicham bhaan gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' ka't a'gi'ñchu' gu oi'ñga'n tɨtdada' uañi'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Israeel jix duñia' soi'ñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu kavɨk jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' ka't a'gi'ñchu' soi'm mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Gabriel ka't buupui gu oi'ñga'n gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu tas gu maa'nkar gu xumai.
Ba' jix aa' jix duu jix duñia' gu chuukug; gio ba' gu Danieel jano' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu chuukug jix duñia' gu suudai'.
Na gu' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu suudai' jix buus gu ñi'ook tu' tɨbiap na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na gu' tu' gu chuukug gu chio'ñ gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Setenta gu chuukug gu takarui' bhaan gu ja'tkam bhaan abhaar kiicham na ba' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug uañi'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx bhai' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n ñi'ook na jix aa'dham Jawatan tu jiim jix bhaan jɨɨgi'ñdham.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt dɨr gu ñi'ook na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem bɨɨx ka'm gu Mesiias gu Priinkipe gu oi'ñga'n kɨɨv gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gook gu chuukug; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ɨrban vaak jodai gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gook gu chuukug jix duñia' gu oidha' gu Mesiias cham gu ux; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gɨ'kora' ja'tkam tu' jix ai gu ñi'ook kiicham xidhuu; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' kia'pɨx jix duñia' ñi'ook na jix bhaan mui'x tɨjɨɨ'ñ kia'pɨx jix duñia' gu suudai' gu maa'nkar; gio ba' mi' dhɨr bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu bhóogɨt dhi' bɨɨx ka'm gu bhóogɨt bɨx; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' vaik oi'ñga' gu Kiro gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia ka't gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu Danieel gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't gu Beltsasar; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug ka't jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook jugi gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh tu' gu Danieel gu jodai' gu ux gu ñi'ook vaik gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' cham jugi gu takarui' jix bhai'x tu' chɨbiapui gu chuukug tu' suudai' u'va gu chin tu' maa'n bɨɨx choi' bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' vaik gu chuukug gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook maakobh gu tanoolh gu takarui' maa'n ka't tu' jugii'ñ gɨ' suudai' jiim gu iddekel.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu vupui gu chuukug gu suudai' gu chio'ñ tɨi'chu' bhiibgich gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai gu Upas.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug ka't na ja'p gu jodai gu suudai' gu vupui gu chuukug gu tasi' gu vupui na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu tai gu novɨ tɨɨt na ja'p jix uam gu jodai' na jix uam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu Danieel tu' mii' dhɨr gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' cham jix duñia' gu chichio'ñ mi'p gu chuukug; gu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bhaan choo'n jiboi'ññor gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' gu duukam tu' dhi' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu suudai'; gio ba' va'k gu kavɨk jix duñia' gu jodai' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug oi'ñdha'.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tɨiñ gu ñi'ook ka't tu' gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu vupui gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' gu novɨ gu ñi'ook bhaan kɨkbok bhaan gu ñi'ook gu noobh.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Danieel gu chio'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook bamii' bhaan tɨɨt; na gu' tu' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jano'; jano' ba' kua' a'gi'ñchu' gu chuukug dhi' tu' ka't gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Danieel cham jum i'obh; na gu' dɨr maa'n gu tanoolh chɨɨdak gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios jix bɨɨx duu gu suudai' gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' kuiñcha gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' tɨbiap.

Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Persia jix dhaas bhaan tu' gu jodai' gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu suudai' gu Miguel maa'n gu ñi'ook chiñia' suudai' u'va na ba' u'ua'tɨdham tu' gu suudai' bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' tɨbiap na ba' gu chuukug maachim tu' jix ai gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt gu tanoolh; na gu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook na ba' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' kua' a'gi'ñchu' gu chuukug tuutu'm gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu vupui gu oidha' gu oi'ñga'n.

Gu' gu' gu suudai' na ja'p na jax chu'm gu mar gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jano' ba' gu takarui' gu chin tu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr ka't vupui bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan gu chuukug bɨɨx gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' jix duñia' gu vaak bhaan tu' cham jix duñia' gu kavɨk.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook gu kutun tu duukam gu Jawatan ñiokda' bɨɨx dhi' gu Jawatan na gu' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu kavɨk cham tu' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr na ja'p na jax chu'm gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu oi'ñga'n cham jum i'obh; mi' dhɨr bhai'x i'ii'ñ tu'; jano' ba' mambhɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' a'gi'ñchu' gu chuukug gu jodai' tu' gu chuukug tu ñi'ook; na gu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan na gu' gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa'; na gu' ñɨidhat gu ux gu ñi'ook tɨbiap tu' na gu' no'ñ gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ux bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Persas; mi' dhɨr gamai' tu' jupaabkamu'n gu ñi'ook gu Grekia.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu jodai' ua'nak gu'p tu'r; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham tu'x jai'ch gu jodai' gu chuukug dhi' tu'x gu ñi'ook gu Miguel gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' oi'ñga' maa'n gu Dariio gu Media tu' gu chuukug na ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jano' tu' gu ñi'ook tu'r; gio ba' gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n vaik gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia maakobh jix duñia' namkɨm gu oi'ñga'n bɨx; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' bɨɨx namkɨm jix duñia' bɨx bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' jix kavɨk jix duñia' bhaan gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' aagak.

Na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n ka't jix bhai'x oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu jodai' gu ux maakobh jɨbɨɨlh gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' bhaan aapi' bɨɨx jix duñia'; na gu' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ka't gu ñi'ook na ba' mai' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix kavɨk gu gɨ'kora' saagi'ñ; gu' maa'n chiñia' gu bhóogɨt daam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr aapi' ka't jix gɨ' aapi'.

Jano' ba' gu maa'nkar gu takarui' jix duñia' mar u'vɨ gu gɨ'kora' saagi'ñ ɨlhdham gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt; gu' cham gu ñi'ook cham gu kutun gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' gu suudai' tu' gu ñi'ook; na gu' ka't kapbhai' gu suudai' gu jodai' gu suudai' gu mar mi'p baasɨ'n mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' maa'n bhaan gu ñi'ook ɨlhdham bɨɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham jix duñia' gu kavɨk gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu chuukug jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx chiñia' bɨɨx gu ux gu takarui' jix toja jodai jix uam jodai jix duñia' gu chuukug gu Ejipto; gio ba' gu ux gu takarui' bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu gɨ'kora' saagi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n chugi'ñ; gio ba' ɨlhdham gu chuukug jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bɨɨx daak bɨɨx ka'm gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' saagi'ñ gu jodai' gu ux bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt yooxi' gu oi'ñga'n bɨx mii' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n ka't kapbhai' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' mui'x gu oi'ñga'n; gu' cham gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' yooxi' jix gɨ' gu oi'ñga'n maa'n gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook gu takarui' ɨlhdham gu chuukug bɨɨx jix gɨ' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx mumua'da' namkɨm.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu ñi'ook mui'x bhaan gu gɨ'kora' saagi'ñ; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ñi'ook na jix aa'dham Jawatan gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' ɨlhdham gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook kiicham jix kavɨk; gio ba' gu novɨ saagi'ñ cham gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' tu' gu ja'tkam gu tasi' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu kavɨk gu bhóogɨt gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' ɨlhdham bhaan jix duñia' aagak tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' jix bhai'x ka't gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu vupui na ba' jix ai bɨɨx gu suudai' bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt tu'x gu ñi'ook maa'n mar u'vɨ gu u'vɨ na ba' bhaan; gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' ka't gu ux.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr gu vupui gu chuukug gu ñi'ook mumua'da'; gu' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu suudai' jix duñia' bhaan gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu bhóogɨt gu oidha'; gu' jix duñia' gu chuukug cham gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook maa'n jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gɇ'kamtu'nda' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; gu' gu jodai' gu tanoolh ka't jix bhai'x cham gu duukam tu' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug pai' gu oi'ñga'n cham jix duñia' nɨidhat oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; gio ba' ɨlhdham cham gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bhai'x i'ii'ñ jix bhɨɨ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bɨɨx gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu novɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu suudai' vupui bhaan ka't gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu suudai' gio gɨ'kora' ja'tkam ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx jix duñia' iatda' jix tɨ'ɨ gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' kua' oidha' gɨ' bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu tasi' jix duñia' cham jix duu tattat tu' tattat; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu takarui' namkɨm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ sandaarui'x; mi' dhɨr bhaan gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu suudai'; jano' ba' dhi' gu ux gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ bhaan gu gɨ'kora' saagi'ñ bɨɨx jix gɨ' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' saagi'ñ gu jodai' bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu bhóogɨt jix kavɨk ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; na gu' gu' cham gu jodai' na gu' jix duu gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jugi gu takarui' jix duñia'; gio ba' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't gu jodai' gu chuukug mui'x koko'kam.

Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ dhi' ja'tkam gook gu gɨ'kora' ka't na ba' gu jodai' cham bhai' gu vaak na jix bhai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu' cham gu ñi'ook cham tu' na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ ka't bhaan ñi'ook na jix bhaan jix bhaan; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook nɨi'ñchudat jix duñia' saagi'ñ; gu' cham ka't gu ñi'ook namkia' na ja'p gu ñi'ook.

Na gu' na gu' aajim bhaan gu takarui' gu jodai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bhaan ñi'ook na jix bhaan jix bhaan jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu novɨ jix bhai'x jix bhaan ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu novɨ baasɨ'n; gio ba' jix duñia' xidhuu gu kavɨk jix duñia' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu maa'nkar jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan; gu' gu ja'tkam jix maati' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' mamatdagɨm gu ja'tkam jix duñia' matda' mui'x; gio ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu tai gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu takarui' gu ux gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug ka't u'ua'tɨdham jix ali' gu chuukug; gio ba' mui'x gu ux bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' dhɨt mamatdagɨm gu chuukug na ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu jodai' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh; na gu' gu suudai' na ba' dhi' cham tu'x jai'ch gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' aagak; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨx gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook kɨɨ'p ka't gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu suudai' daak; na gu' gu kutun gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tattat cham jix duñia' tu' xoi'kam gu u'vɨ; na gu' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios oi'ñdha' na gu' bhaan bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook pai' gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios tattat cham jix maati'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu jodai a'bhar bɨɨx tu'x u'uuk.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' jix duñia' gu suudai' gu takarui' gɇ'kamtu'nda'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu takarui' bhaan mui'x gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha'.

Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' saagi'ñ jix duñia' bɨɨx; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bhaan na ja'p gu suudai' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam kavaayo mui'x gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ux oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ɨlhdham gu oidha' jix bhai'x mumua'da' oidha' gɨ' gu chuukug; gu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ; mi' dhɨr gu Edom gu Moab maa'n gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu novɨ oi'ñga'n cham jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu jodai' na jix uam jix uam jodai jix toja jodai bɨx tu'x a'bhar gu Ejipto gu Libia gu jodai' gu ux pai' gu ux.
Gu' gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tas buusñi gu ñi'ook jix duñia'; gio ba' gu jodai' bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu vaak na ba' cham tu' duu kooda' mui'x.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook vaak zel gu kutun tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' gu kavɨk jix bhai'x xidhuu; gio ba' ɨlhdham bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook cham gu oi'ñga'n u'ua'tɨdham.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Miguel gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu chuukug cham pai' dhuuk ka't mi' dhɨr ka't gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka'm jano' ba'; gu' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu jodai' u'uan.
Jano' ba' mui'x gu ñi'ook oo' gu oidha' ka't gu chuukug na ba' gu oidha' baidhika' na ba' xi'ɨraam gu jodai' na jix uam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' pui'm gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx bhai' gu oi'ñga'n na ja'p gu si'avag gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Danieel gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu chuukug u'uan bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' mui'x jix mui' gu duukam.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Danieel gu chuukug gu suudai' gook mi'p maa'n dhi' baasɨ'n jugii'ñ gɨ' suudai' jiim baasɨ'n jugii'ñ gɨ' suudai' jiim.
Ba' jix aa' maa'n gu chio'ñ tɨi'chu' bhiibgich ka't bhaan gu suudai' gɨ' suudai' jiim; gio ba' duuk ka't gu ñi'ook dhi' kɨɨ'p.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ tɨi'chu' bhiibgich ka't bhaan gu suudai' gɨ' suudai' jiim jix duñia' kɨɨ'n gu jodai' gu tɨkɨr gu ñi'ook gu ux na jix do'ig gu suudai' ka't gu ux gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu ja'tkam jix bhaan bɨx dhi' tu'x ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan gu chuukug gu ñi'ook ka't gu oi'ñga'n dhi' tu'x.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jiim gu Danieel dhi' gu ñi'ook jix kup gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' mui'x ka't gu suudai' gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt; gu' jix bhai'x jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai'x jix duñia' gu' jix duñia' pui'm.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu ñi'ook ka't gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu vaak na jix bhai' gu maa'nkar bɨɨx ka'm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx ka'm jix bhai'x vaik gu ñi'ook jixchamaam gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh.
